name: 18364-batchdecode-qwen8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16, unquantized, ungated on HF and already in the local cache (~16 GB of weights).
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one card of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, no speculative decoding.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=80, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 800 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, streaming. 3500 prompt tokens against 200 output tokens, both fixed with no spread, temperature 0.0, ignore_eos true, seed 42.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter document summarizer streaming short summaries of long reports to 80 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form.
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line -- a nested block is DROPPED silently, and every key
# below is a real ServerArgs field at the pinned commit.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: flashinfer
disable-radix-cache: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.83
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
random-seed: 42
